facts: Parties: Glenrock Systems Ltd (Buyer), Arden Systems Ltd (Seller); the Company is Calloway Pharma plc.
This Agreement is dated 27 December 2025; Closing is scheduled for 21 February 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 150 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 27 December 2025), either party may terminate.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $2,000,000.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.

Clause 4.1: the Escrow Amount shall be released to the Seller on the date falling 12 months after the Closing Date, save to the extent of pending claims notified before that date. 'Business Day' means a day other than a Saturday or Sunday on which banks are open in London.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 10 July 2026.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $1,090,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $253,180,000.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Arden Software Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
